args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the docstring and `tests/test_money.py` expect banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212. This caused the nightly build test failure.

## Change
- Switched the rounding mode in `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` passed.
- Tests confirm: `2.675 -> 2.68` (ties resolved per FIN-212), `2.665 -> 2.66` (half-even behavior).
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Fix banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

transcript.reasoning_content: Let me start by listing files and reading the relevant files.

transcript.content: The bug is clear: the docstring says ROUND_HALF_EVEN, but the code uses ROUND_HALF_UP. I'll fix it on a new branch.
transcript.reasoning_content: The test is odd: 2.675 with half-even → 2.68 (since 7 is odd, round up to 8 — wait, 2.675 → half even looks at last kept digit 7 (odd), so rounds to 2.68). And 2.665 → last kept digit 6 (even), so rounds to 2.66. Yes, ROUND_HALF_EVEN gives both. The comment says banker's rounding. So fix: import ROUND_HALF_EVEN.
